module.purpose: Provides a mutable, chainable path construction abstraction that records move, line, cubic, and arc commands, then converts them into SVG, Path2D, or geometry representations.
module.summary: This module builds renderable vector paths while preserving per-command styling, closure, geometry, dash, and hand-drawn metadata. It approximates elliptical arcs with cubic Bézier segments, supports affine transformation and path serialization, calculates segment metadata for rendering, and exposes geometry adapters for hit testing and vertex queries. Rendering supports solid, dashed, dotted, and randomized draw-style output.
module.businessContext: Supports tldraw shape rendering, hit testing, and geometry calculations. Failures can produce incorrect outlines, fills, snapping, selection bounds, or exported SVG paths.

detail.name: lineThroughPoints
preconditions: points must contain at least one point with numeric x and y coordinates.
postconditions: Returns a PathBuilder representing a path beginning at points[0] and proceeding through the remaining points in array order.
invariants: Point order is preserved in the generated path.
The generated path contains straight-line connections between successive supplied points.
edgeCases: A single point produces a path whose initial position is that point and has no subsequent point-to-point segment.
An empty points array attempts to access the first point and fails before producing a usable path.
When opts.endOffsets is provided, it is used as the offset for the initial move instead of opts.offset.
When opts.endOffsets is absent, the initial move uses opts.offset if provided.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Invalid point data is not validated explicitly; runtime behavior follows property access and path-builder operations.

detail.summary: Creates a path that begins at the first supplied point and connects the points in order with line segments. Line options are applied to the generated path, with endOffsets taking precedence over offset for the initial move.

specTests.then: the returned path starts at the first point and contains line connections to the second and third points in order.

preconditions: Each point in points provides numeric x and y coordinates.
points contains at least one point.
postconditions: Returns a PathBuilder whose path starts at points[0].
For each consecutive pair of points, the returned path contains one cubic spline segment ending at the next point.

Interior cubic control points are derived from neighboring points using a one-sixth tangent factor scaled by 1.25.
The first segment's first control point is the first path point.
The last segment's second control point is the final path point.

detail.name: arcTo
detail.signature: arcTo(rx: number, ry: number, largeArcFlag: boolean, sweepFlag: boolean, xAxisRotationRadians: number, x2: number, y2: number, opts?: PathBuilderCommandOpts)
preconditions: The path must already contain a move-to command.
postconditions: Returns the same PathBuilder instance.
If the endpoints differ and both radii are nonzero, the path contains a cubic Bézier approximation of the requested elliptical arc.
If either radius is zero, the path is extended with a straight line to (x2, y2), using opts.
If the current point equals (x2, y2), no command is added.
invariants: The current path endpoint after normal completion is (x2, y2) whenever a non-degenerate arc or fallback line is added.
Negative radii are treated as their absolute values.
An arc is split into no more than four segments, with segment boundaries covering the computed sweep angle.
Radii are scaled when necessary so the requested endpoints are reachable by the ellipse.
edgeCases: No prior move-to command: the method fails through assertHasMoveTo rather than appending geometry.
Identical current and target endpoints: returns the builder without adding a command.
Either rx or ry is zero: delegates to lineTo(x2, y2, opts) and produces a straight-line result.
Negative radii: radii are converted to positive values before arc computation.
Radii too small to connect the endpoints: both radii are scaled by the computed correction factor.
A computed center-term radicand below zero: it is clamped to zero before taking the square root.

raises: The error produced by assertHasMoveTo when the path has no move-to command.
errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit validation is performed for numeric or flag arguments; degenerate zero-radius and coincident-endpoint cases use the documented fallback behavior.

stateMutations: Mutates this.commands by appending the generated cubic Bézier commands or the fallback line command.
detail.summary: Appends an elliptical arc from the current path point to the requested endpoint, approximating the arc with cubic Bézier segments. Degenerate arcs are handled as no-ops or straight lines while preserving the builder chain.
